identification: Framed watercolour 'Lake Scene' attributed by catalogue to Helen Matthews: loose wet-into-wet view of a lagoon or wetland with reed islands, a red-brown marsh band, distant low hills, pale sky. Grey-mauve mat, silver moulded frame, stock label 5713/4 on the mat. Image about 24 x 37 cm. Amateur/local exhibition standard. Estimate 30-50, current bid $10.
